_comment: v2 (corrected-detrend retrain nn_24lb_72fh_v2) 2-year GEFS ensemble archive config for inference_ensemble_v2.py. Same synoptic 00/06/12/18Z cycle grid, span, members, and seeds as the v1 run (gefs_psfc_v1_raw) so the two archives are directly comparable; only the model/data/scaler paths and the experiment tag differ. Pressure contract is PSFC ('v2' = detrend retrain, not the shelved MSLP track). Off-grid OFS anchors (ngofs2/sfbofs 03/09/15/21Z, wcofs 03Z) are NOT in this pass - if a later figure needs them, run an additive pass under a separate experiment tag.
